channel: Catch-up (wage response to past unexpected inflation)
bb_measure: catch-up = 4-quarter avg CPI inflation minus 1y expectation (cf1) 4 quarters earlier (Table 1 p.13; construction p.16). Eq 2-3 p.7
bb_role_in_2021_23: Not significant: lag sum -0.024, p=0.765 (Table 2 p.17); +0.1 (n.s.) with SPF (p.18); small in full sample. 'Weak catch-up effect' (p.39). A smaller channel than expectations for price-shock pass-through to wages (p.35)
value_2021_23: Coefficient ~0 (above). Size of the catch-up variable itself not reported in text
now_measure_proxy: BB construction (CPI 4q avg minus Cleveland 1y four quarters earlier) needs CPI + cf1; survey evidence (Atlanta Fed BIE, NFIB compensation plans, Conference Board) from Agent B as qualitative proxy
notes: Surveys are not BB's measure; label as proxy. BB's own estimate implies catch-up shows up via wages only if the coefficient has changed, which BB could not test post-2023.
